claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day,8-hour journey around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar flight since 1972.
The Artemis II mission includes NASA’s Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II mission includes Victor Glover.
The Artemis II mission includes Christina Koch.
The Artemis II mission includes Canadian Space Agency’s Jeremy Hansen.
